snippet.title: DOPAMINE | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
ROLL ROLL ROLL! DOPAMINE Makes it's way into YOUR steam store page with a hype and addicting gameplay loop!

An online 1-4 player co-op physics-based “rube-goldberg-like” gambling game! Place ramps, cannons, turrets, and other contraptions in the name of maximum Dopamine. Unlock zany items to harass your friends, avoid dangerous side effects of gambling, and survive the clinic trial…
